H5200.def: patronymic from «05199»; a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah:--Netophathite.

H5201.def: a primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger):--bear grudge, keep(-er), reserve.

H5203.def: a primitive root; properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.):--cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.def: a doubtful word; apparently from «05091»; lamentation:-- wailing.

H5205.def: from «05110»; motion (of the lips in speech):--moving.

H5207.def: or niychoach {nee-kho'-akh}; from «05117»; properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight:--sweet (odour).

H5208.def: (Aramaic) or (shorter) niychoach (Aramaic) {nee-kho'-akh}; corresponding to «05207»; pleasure:--sweet odour (savour).

H5210.def: of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria:--Nineveh.

H5212.def: probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year:--Nisan.

H5214.et: a root probably identical with that of (05216), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow
H5214.def: a root probably identical with that of «05216», through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow; to till the soil:--break up.

H5215.def: or nir {neer}; from «05214»; properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land:--fallow ground, plowing, tillage.

H5216.et: from a primitive root [see (05214); (05135)] properly, meaning to glisten
H5216.def: or nir {neer}; also neyr {nare}; or ner {nare}; or (feminine) nerah {nay-raw'}; from a primitive root (see «05214»; «05135») properly, meaning to glisten; a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively):--candle, lamp, light.

H5217.def: a primitive root; to smite, i.e. drive away:--be viler.

H5218.def: or nakat {naw-kaw'}; from «05217»; smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted:--broken, stricken, wounded.

H5219.def: from «05218»; properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered):--spicery(-ces).

H5220.et: from an unused root meaning to propagate
H5220.def: from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring:--nephew, son's son.

H5221.def: a primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively):--beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), × go forward, × indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, × surely, wound.

H5223.def: smitten, i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected:--contrite, lame.

H5224.def: probably of Egyptian origin; Neko, an Egyptian king:--Necho. Compare «06549».

H5225.def: from «03559»; prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite:--Nachon.

H5226.et: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward
H5226.def: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward; properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite:--before, over against.

H5227.def: from the same as «05226»; properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of:--(over) against, before, direct(-ly), for, right (on).

H5228.def: from the same as «05226»; straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity:--plain, right, uprightness.

H5229.def: feminine of «05228»; properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth:--equity, right (thing), uprightness.

H5230.def: a prim root; to defraud, i.e. act treacherously:--beguile, conspire, deceiver, deal subtilly.

H5233.et: from an unused root meaning to accumulate
H5233.def: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; treasure:--riches, wealth.

H5234.def: a primitive root; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning):--acknowledge, × could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange(-ly).

H5235.def: or noker {no'-ker}; from «05234»; something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity:--strange.

H5236.def: ' from «05234»; foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom:--alien, strange (+ -er).

H5237.def: from «05235» (second form); strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful):--alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange(-r, woman).

H5238.def: probably for «05219»; spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables:--precious things.

H5239.def: apparently a primitive root; to complete:--make an end.

H5241.def: apparently for «03223»; Nemuel, the name of two Israelites:--Nemuel.

H5242.def: from «05241»; a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel:--Nemuelite.

H5243.def: a primitive root; to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised:--(branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.

H5244.def: feminine from «05243»; an ant (probably from its almost bisected form):--ant.

H5246.et: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid [comp (05247) and (05249)]
H5246.def: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp «05247» and «05249»); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping; a leopard (from its stripes):--leopard.

H5247.def: from the same as «05246»; clear water; Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan:--Nimrah. See also «01039», «05249».

H5248.def: or Nimrod {nim-rode'}; probably of foreign origin; Nimrod, a son of Cush:--Nimrod.

H5249.def: plural of a masculine corresponding to «05247»; clear waters; Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan:--Nimrim. Compare «01039».

H5250.def: probably from «04871»; extricated; Nimshi, the (grand-)father of Jehu:--Nimshi.

H5251.def: from «05264»; a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token:--banner, pole, sail, (en-)sign, standard.

H5252.def: feminine participle passive of «05437»; properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs:--cause.

H5253.def: a primitive root; to retreat:--departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.

H5254.def: a primitive root; to test; by implication, to attempt:--adventure, assay, prove, tempt, try.

H5255.def: a primitive root; to tear away:--destroy, pluck, root.

H5257.def: from «05258»; properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed):--drink offering, duke, prince(-ipal).

H5258.def: a primitive root; to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint a king:--cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

H5259.et: a primitive root [probably identical with (05258) through the idea fusion]
H5259.def: a primitive root (probably identical with «05258» through the idea of fusion); to interweave, i.e. (figuratively) to overspread:--that is spread.

H5260.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05258»; to pour out a libation:--offer.

H5262.def: or necek {nay'-sek}; from «05258»; a libation; also a cast idol:--cover, drink offering, molten image.

H5263.def: a primitive root; to wane, i.e. be sick:--faint.

H5264.def: a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from «05251» (and identical with «05263», through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind); to raise a beacon:--lift up as an ensign.

H5265.def: a primitive root; properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on a journey:--cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), × still, be on his (go their) way.

H5266.def: a primitive root; to go up:--ascend.

H5268.def: of foreign origin; Nisrok, a Babylonian idol:--Nisroch.

H5269.def: from «05128»; motion; Neah, a place in Palestine:--Neah.

H5271.et: properly, pass. participle from (05288) as denominative
H5271.def: or naur {naw-oor'}; and (feminine) nturah {neh- oo-raw'}; properly, passive participle from «05288» as denominative; (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people):--childhood, youth.

H5272.def: from «05128» and «0410»; moved of God; Neiel, a place in Palestine:--Neiel.

H5273.def: from «05276»; delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative):--pleasant(-ure), sweet.

H5274.def: a primitive root; properly, to fasten up, i.e. with a bar or cord; hence (denominative from «05275»), to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers:--bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.

H5275.def: or (feminine) na;alah {nah-al-aw'}; from «05274»; properly, a sandal tongue; by extens. a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless):--dryshod, (pair of) shoe((-latchet), -s).

H5276.def: a primitive root; to be agreeable (literally or figuratively):--pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

H5278.def: from «05276»; agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace:--beauty, pleasant(-ness).

H5279.def: feminine of «05277»; pleasantness; Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine:--Naamah.

H5280.def: patronymic from «05283»; a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively):--Naamites.

H5283.def: the same as «05282»; Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene:--Naaman.

H5284.et: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with (05279)
H5284.def: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with «05279»; a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah:--Naamathite.

H5285.et: from an unused root meaning to prick
H5285.def: from an unused root meaning to prick; probably a brier; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes:--thorn.

H5287.et: a primitive root [probably identical with (05286), through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar]
H5287.def: a primitive root (probably identical with «05286», through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar); to tumble about:--shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

H5288.def: from «05287»; (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age):--babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

H5289.et: from (05287) in its derivative sense of tossing about
H5289.def: from «05287» in its derivative sense of tossing about; a wanderer:--young one.

H5291.def: feminine of «05288»; a girl (from infancy to adolescence):--damsel, maid(-en), young (woman).

H5292.def: the same as «05291»; Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine:--Naarah, Naarath.

H5294.def: from «05288» and «03050»; servant of Jah; Nearjah, the name of two Israelites:--Neariah.

H5295.def: from «05288»; juvenile; Naaran, a place in Palestine:--Naaran.

H5296.def: from «05287»; something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax):--tow.

H5297.def: a variation of «04644»; Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt:--Noph.

H5298.et: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth
H5298.def: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout; Nepheg, the name of two Israelites:--Nepheg.

H5299.et: from (05130) in the sense of lifting
H5299.def: from «05130» in the sense of lifting; a height; also a sieve:--border, coast, region, sieve.
